lastCompletedStory.title: Orchestrator boot step 9: read the preflight-failed marker

nextStoryContext: US-005 was the last of 5 stories in this PRD (CAM-215, plan-preflight-failed surfacing); all userStories[] now have passes:true, no requires:'operator' entries remain. This is pure doc-authoring + codegen, no plan-runner.ts/sidecar.ts code seam: both copies of subagent-orchestrator.md (.claude/agents/ and templates/agents/, confirmed NOT byte-identical except the tools/disallowedTools frontmatter ordering per the cam-dual-copy-is-per-file gotcha -- body text was otherwise identical before this edit) gained boot step 9 (reads .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json, whose shape is { step: string, detail: string, writtenAt: string }, no issueId -- see src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts from US-002) plus an opening-blocker section placed directly after the existing plan-escalated blocker section, mirroring its exact prose shape ('Do NOT delete the marker yourself... only removed by <X>'). The blocker example line is `⚠ plan preflight failed: <step> — <detail (first line; +N more if multi-line)>`, referencing the existing truncatePreflightDetail() helper's contract (US-002) without needing to call it from prose (this is documentation, not code). Ran `bun run embed-vendor` after editing templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md so src/vendor/_generated.ts's templatesContents['agents/subagent-orchestrator.md'] carries the new step; embed-vendor:check is clean. Added test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts (new test/templates/ directory -- did not exist before) asserting BOTH copies via describe.each: the dev copy read directly with readFileSync (never embedded in templatesContents, only templates/ is), the template copy read via templatesContents post-embed. Assertions use content.indexOf() ordering chains (step7Index < step8Index < step9Index) to prove placement AFTER steps 7/8, not just presence anywhere in the file -- a bare toContain would pass even if the new step landed in the wrong place. Full quality spine (bun run check:all) is green: typecheck 0 errors, 3801 pass / 0 fail (10 new in this story), lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity all ok. Next agent: since all 5 stories pass and review has presumably not yet run for this PRD cycle, the orchestrator should route to /cam-review next (per the stop-condition in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md), not another /cam-next -- there is no more implementation work in this PRD.
